subject: MAP: asset-swap & test-case access plan for evaluation
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Bishop <ethan@acmeretail.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: asset-swap & test-case access plan for evaluation

Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I put together a short mutual action plan so we can exchange evaluation assets (prompt packs + test cases) and close the pilot commitment on a predictable timeline. High level: Redwood will provide a prompt pack and a curated set of test cases; Acme will provide a small masked sample and sign the one-way asset use addendum.

Deliverables (Redwood):
- Prompt pack v1 (prompts + example outputs) — attachment: redwood_promptpack_v1.zip
- Evaluation manifest (CSV with test case ids, tags, expected behavior) — attachment: redwood_eval_manifest.csv
- MAP proposal (steps/timeline/acceptance criteria) — attachment: MAP_proposal_v1.docx

Acme asks: sample production queries for contextual relevance, and clarity on retention/usage constraints. Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Tue 4/7: Redwood shares artifacts (today)
- Fri 4/10: Acme reviews masked sample + returns feedback or redlines
- Wed 4/15: Finalize MAP; DocuSign signature; sandbox keys issued
- Mon 4/20: Pilot evaluation window starts (30 days)

Usage constraints we propose (draft):
- Evaluation-only: assets may be used by Acme solely to evaluate Redwood in the pilot; no model training or external redistribution.
- Access limited to up to 3 named engineers 
- Retention: delete vendor-provided files after 45 days unless otherwise agreed

Can you confirm whether the timeline and constraints are acceptable? If you want any changes, please mark up MAP_proposal_v1.docx and return. Once we have a signed addendum we can send keys and the prompt pack.

Thanks — we want to make this low friction and fast.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: redwood_promptpack_v1.zip (zip of .txt prompts), redwood_eval_manifest.csv (CSV)
From: Ethan Bishop <ethan@acmeretail.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jill Murray <jill@acmeretail.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2026 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP: asset-swap & test-case access plan for evaluation

Kimberly —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and clear plan. A few quick clarifying points from our side before we sign: 

1) Masking: we'll only share masked samples. We attached acme_masked_sample.json as an example. Please confirm that Redwood will not persist any unmasked or PII-containing elements.
2) Retention: 45 days is close to what procurement expects; they may ask for 30 days maximum. Can you confirm if Redwood can do 30 days on vendor files?
3) Usage: procurement/legal will insist on a clause that explicitly prohibits using our sample data for training.

Also, can you confirm the names of the 3 engineers who will get access from our side? We'll add them to the access list once we agree.

On timeline — 4/15 signature looks fine. If we can get the MAP redlines back earlier, we can still hit the 4/20 start.

Thanks,
Ethan Bishop
Principal Data Scientist, Acme Retail
ethan@acmeretail.ai

Attachment: acme_masked_sample.json (small masked sample)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2026 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP: asset-swap & test-case access plan for evaluation

Looping legal and SEs. My take: we can accept 30-day deletion if we add a 15-day remediation buffer for any audit/archive requests — effectively 45 days from receipt for Redwood retention, but Acme can require deletion on their timeline from the delivery date. Important to make the training prohibition explicit (no fine-tuning / no re-release as part of a public corpus).

Marcus — please confirm the smallest deliverable set you need to run the evaluation (counts / format). If we can reduce the initial package (200 curated test cases + prompt pack) rather than the full 500 we'll lower risk. 

Laura — can you prepare a short one-way addendum that covers: no training, max 3 named engineers, 30-day deletion requested by customer (Redwood asks 15-day compliance window), audit log sharing weekly, and no redistribution. I'll flag price/credits as negotiable in the MAP.

Ben
VP, Sales
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Bishop <ethan@acmeretail.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: asset-swap & test-case access plan for evaluation

Ethan —

Quick update after internal alignment: we can move forward with the following (summary + updated timeline).

Redwood deliverables (updated):
- Prompt pack v1 (same)
- Curated test cases: initial tranche = 200 test cases (CSV + JSON payloads) — we will stage the remainder after initial evaluation if needed
- Evaluation manifest (same)

Updated usage & retention:
- Evaluation-only, explicit prohibition on training models with provided artifacts
- Access limited to up to 3 named Acme engineers (please share names)
- Redwood will remove the vendor-provided files from temporary storage within 30 days of delivery; Redwood will retain audit logs for 45 days to support compliance requests

Updated timeline: 
- Mon 4/12: Redwood sends initial tranche (we'll send s3 links + MAP doc) — pending DocuSign signature
- Thu 4/15: Target for signed one-way addendum (DocuSign)
- Tue 4/20: Evaluation window open (30 days)

Next actions for you: please review attached MAP_proposal_v1.docx and the sample we received; confirm engineer names and whether procurement needs any more specific language around retention or auditability. If you confirm names I will request DocuSign be prepared.

Best —
Kimberly

Attachment stubs: MAP_proposal_v1.docx (updated with timeline)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Bishop <ethan@acmeretail.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: asset-swap & test-case access plan for evaluation — Redwood addendum redlines

Ethan / Kimberly —

Attached are the redlines to the MAP one-way addendum (redlines_MAP_acme.docx). Summary of legal points included in the redlines: 
- Explicit prohibition: provided assets may not be used to train, fine-tune, or improve any machine learning models; permitted use is evaluation only.
- Access: limited to 3 named engineers. Addendum requires a list to be provided before keys issued.
- Retention: Acme may request deletion within 30 days; Redwood will remove files and confirm deletion within 15 business days of such request. Audit logs will be retained for 45 days and made available on a weekly basis while the evaluation is active.
- No redistribution: assets cannot be redistributed to third parties or posted to public datasets.
- Indemnity & liability: standard limited liability clause; nothing unusual.

If these are acceptable, Kimberly please route to Ethan for signature via DocuSign (we'll prepare the DocuSign envelope). If Acme has procurement redlines, please have them mark the doc and return; we'll do a final pass.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: redlines_MAP_acme.docx (track changes)
